reviews.author: Martin J
reviews.text: Anthony put up a wall in our house and did a great job with it. Great attention to details and not settling with an just OK result. Greatly recommend them.

reviews.author: Tanner Blankenship
reviews.text: Anthony and CCR did the shingles on my home last year and they did an incredible job. Was a tough job with some weird valleys but they pulled it off perfectly. They also did a great job on the guttering and fascia. Will call them again next time.

reviews.author: Beth Ousley
reviews.text: Anthony came out and scraped our driveway from the snow and ice They did a wonderful job! I highly recommend them and will use them again!

reviews.author: Rick Sullivan
reviews.text: CCR Home Improvements did excellent work for me cleaning and readjusting my gutters as well as installing gutter covers. The price was fair, the communication was very good, the workmanship exactly what I expected, and I felt very comfortable that Anthony will stand by his work in case we have any issue requiring follow-up. You should consider them for your next project.

reviews.author: Taylor Rollo
reviews.text: Great guys who did a great job replacing some siding on my house, and they did it at a reasonable price as well. The work was done well, done quickly, they explained things well, and they were even kind to my four year old who talked their ears off until my wife made him come inside. :) The owner also has answered followup questions from me via text quickly and helpfully. If I need this kind of work done, I will call them again.

reviews.author: Lisa Wood
reviews.text: CCR Home Improvement just finished rebuilding our chimney Chase and did an excellent job. Their attention to detail and workmanship show that they take pride in their work. The cost was great too! When they finished the job they left the area clean. We will definitely contact them again. Thank you Anthony and crew!

reviews.author: Mary Anne Hecht
reviews.text: Hello, the crew that came to our house went above and beyond. We had initially ask for gutter cleaning; they saw that the roof had a lot of moss and mildew. Without skipping a beat, they went ahead and cleaned the roof to free it of that debris, without charging us for that service! They showed care and concern for this property, knowing that clearing the gutters wouldn't be set without the roof being clean and clear. We would definitely recommend them for their expertise, genuine customer service, and professionalism. Superbly handled and delivered. Thank you CCR Home Improvements! We will be calling you for all our home's needs.

reviews.author: thomas hillier
reviews.text: 0 stars if I could. First of all, they were used during the purchase of my home to estimate the cost of a new roof. This cost was then split between the seller and I in the sale. Fast forward to trying to use CCR, it took them months to do another estimate, even though I had the paperwork from the one mentioned above. They said the initial estimate was too low (meaning I'm already losing money on this transaction). I go forward with the service, even booked a date (where I again had to wait months) and they never even showed up. They began to screen my calls and avoid me. They stopped texting me back as well. Now that my roof has an issue, I've been inspired to write this. If they just did the service they promised there would be no issue. Avoid at all costs. There's no fixing this, since I'm now forced to go with someone else.

reviews.author: Nick Caruso
reviews.text: I called first thing in the morning because I noticed water coming in below our window and thought we needed them to be fixed or replaced. Anthony came by about 3 hours later that same day to check it out and give us an estimate. Fortunately (or unfortunately) the window wasn't a problem but Anthony was nice enough to walk me through what I needed to do to fix our water issue. I hope we don't have future issues, but I know who I would call if we do.

reviews.author: Allen
reviews.text: Mr. Cromer and his team did a fantastic job. They showed up on time and replaced our roof. It was an excellent experience and a reasonable price. I will definitely call them again if I need anything else done on our house.

reviews.author: Allen MacDonald
reviews.text: Anthony and his team put our roof on last year. We needed to have our drip edge readjusted. Anthony guarantees his work, he fit us into their extremely busy schedule (the good ones are always busy) and took care of it. They are easily the best group in Montgomery county.

reviews.author: KittyCat
reviews.text: I had contacted them by email on Aug. 31 that I needed a quote asap because my siding had started to leak water into our walls. He responded that he would get someone out. He did not respond to my email asking him to let me know what day and time. Heard nothing more out of him. Fast forward to Wed. Sept. 16, I received a call from CCR, asking if I still needed help with our siding. I said YES! She told me that someone can come out the next day after 6:30pm. I said that's fine. Next day, the guy never showed up, no phone call, no nothing. Nightfall came and I said screw these people! These people are a joke and I know now that I will never want their business. I understand that contractors are busy but DO NOT call potential customers and say someone will be there just to stand people up. What a way to piss people off!

reviews.author: Donna Speaks
reviews.text: CCR Home Improvements renovated an old building space for my cafe and did an outstanding job. Anthony is always fair and gives creative suggestions for improvements, if you need help deciding. Check Facebook for photos of his work and then call to get the job done right!

reviews.author: phyllis hampton
reviews.text: We had this company rebuild steps . They finished the work in a timely manner and communicated with us throughout the process. Did a nice job and and completely cleaned up after the project was finished. Will definitely use their services again.

reviews.author: Jim McAlister
reviews.text: Anthony came to my house to replace a piece of siding that blew off from recent high wind. He has also helped me with siding on recent property. Very professional and prompt. We appreciate Anthony.

reviews.author: Dale Paff
reviews.text: Horrible!!! Called because the wind blew some siding off my house. The man that answered told me he would come by that afternoon. He didn’t. Called and had to leave a message because I don’t have a 540 number, and they don’t want spam calls. Two days later still no call back. Going to find a contractor who is actually honest and responsive.

reviews.author: Kurt Zimmerman
reviews.text: CCR installed new roofing and gutters on our home and replaced skylights. Very pleased with the quality of the work, fair pricing and communication throughout the project.

reviews.author: John Sutherland
reviews.text: Never got a return call ! up Date 4/12 Anthony came to my house and looked at the problem and omittedly knew what was wrong! waiting on a Quote and the Date he can do the job.Will up date later when he does the work

reviews.author: Alan Cummins
reviews.text: We needed a piece of siding put back on our house and Anthony came out and put it back up for us in no time. Was very prompt and professional! We are having him come back to look at a couple windows that need repaired and/or replaced.

reviews.author: Jennifer Harris
reviews.text: CCR Home Improvements does excellent work that is above and beyond the original job. If you need something done and want a good price and a good job give CCR a call.

reviews.author: Michael Reed
reviews.text: Fast turn around on estimate and ahead of schedule for installation of seamless gutters. Great work. Very professional. Good price.

reviews.author: Rosanna Breaux
reviews.text: Good communication, with a fast time to come out and measure gutters to provide estimate. Gave three different options, without pressure to go for most expensive one. Very pleased with service.

reviews.author: William Parmer
reviews.text: Excellent service and a professional experience with CCR. They were very knowledgable and gave great advice on how to fix out gutter issues and their quote was extremely reasonable. I highly recommend.

reviews.author: T.J. Frye
reviews.text: Called to get a peice of siding repaired that the wind had caught. Some woman answered and said she would reach out to the owner and would call me back, never heard anything back. At least a call back to say they couldn't do it would have been nice.

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.text: Called them about a missing/broken shingle on my roof, they came out the next day and fixed it. Great pricing and work.

reviews.author: Paul Field
reviews.text: Awesome work done for a very reasonable price. Honest and quality work. Awesome attention to detail. I'll use again and would recommend to everyone. Thanks Anthony!!!

reviews.author: Adrian Rygas
reviews.text: Great to work with and always quality work. Re shingled and repaired our biggest investments roof last year. Thanks

reviews.author: Nicole Banfield
reviews.text: Very professional and got the job done in a timely manner and most importantly done right! Definitely saving info for any future repairs

reviews.author: Michael Cole
reviews.text: As a contactor I can say that CCR HomeImprovement is a great business to work with, you will always get a professional job done right.

reviews.author: ted li
reviews.text: Provided quote to install siding for the entire house and then just stopped responding completely. Wasted weeks of my time.
